checks.name: test users are excluded from both counts
checks.sql: with e as (select a.account_id, count(u.user_id) as users, count(d.user_id) as named from raw.accounts a left join raw.users u on u.account_id = a.account_id and not u.is_test left join raw.display_names d on d.user_id = u.user_id group by 1) select count(*) from main.account_user_summary s join e using (account_id) where s.user_count is distinct from e.users or s.named_users is distinct from e.named
